They’re social, playful and just a very successful bird,” she says while seated in a corner of a bird observatory in the Lake Erie Islands archipelago. “They’re quite an intelligent problem solver.” The observatory, which she set up with her late partner, Graeme Gibson, is located on the west shore of Pelee Island – the southernmost community in Canada – and is so new that… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.

item.title: ‘In our deepest hearts we are voyeurs’: the paedophile-hunting show that inspired Robert Pattinson’s new film
item.description: Experts and insiders explain how To Catch A Predator became the most controversial show on 2000s TV A man from Long Beach, California, is here to have sex with someone he believes is a 13-year-old girl. When the journalist Chris Hansen walks in, the man’s stomach drops. He is caught, and it is the end of his life as he knew it. Hansen asks what his fate should be. “The electric chair?” he asks. No, replies Hansen. “Dateline NBC.” This is the opening scene of Primetime , a film directed by Lance Oppenheim, released in the US this week (a UK release follows on 30 October). It explores how a… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.

item.title: MNEK on writing smash hits, battling self-doubt and his solo struggles: ‘I’m a fat Black gay man. Try selling that’
item.description: The artist has written for Beyoncé and been nominated for two Grammys, yet individual success has eluded him. Now he’s back with a new album that puts queer joy in the spotlight – and, he says, he’s finally ready to enjoy himself In a south-east London warehouse, Uzoechi Osisioma Emenike, more commonly known as MNEK, is sitting on a bench in a makeshift locker room surrounded by semi-naked men. One particularly muscular individual suggestively adjusts a jockstrap, while another, taller and toned, removes his vest before eyeing MNEK with a loaded gaze. It’s a lot of sexual tension for a… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.

item.title: Meryl Streep’s casting as Aslan has angered the Christian right. Don’t they have more pressing issues?
item.description: The Oscar-winner is voicing Narnia’s wise lion in Greta Gerwig’s adaptation of The Magician’s Nephew, leading to roars of fury from US evangelical commentators It is a confusing time to be alive, given how often these days Hollywood indulges in revisionism. Who knew that the Wicked Witch of the West was the heroine after all, that Cruella de Vil simply had a difficult childhood , or that Mufasa was adopted ? item.title: US rapper Macklemore announces “free Palestine” concerts
item.description: PRESS REVIEW – Friday, September 25: There's anticipation and excitement in France as Pope Leo XIV embarks on the first papal visit to France in 18 years. It comes at a time of renewed Catholic faith among young French people. Also, we look at reactions after Italy's new legislation banning full-face Islamic headwear from schools. Plus: US rapper Macklemore announces a new "Free Palestine" tour that will raise funds for humanitarian groups. Publicado también por: France 24 - English, BBC News - World. Fuente: Africanews.

item.title: Organizan en Barcelona la primera fiesta para gente alta. Altura mínima obligatoria: 1,82 m
item.description: Gandalf nunca tuvo este problema. Medía lo que le daba la gana y los hobbits se adaptaban. En Barcelona, por primera vez, se ha montado una fiesta exclusiva donde el listón (literal) está un poco más alto que la media española: en 1,85 metros. Si no lo superas, te quedas fuera mirando por la ventana como el Kevin de ‘ Solo en casa’ . Tras la idea está Eloi Rodríguez, de apenas 24 años: trabaja como DJ y organiza eventos, y recuerda que "en los conciertos todo el mundo te odia". El viernes 2 de octubre se inaugura y la entrada son 15 euros, consumición incluida. Y los datos dicen que la… Fuente: Xataka.
